meta.title: Style Studio · 风格工作台
meta.description: A "Style Studio" page in the left sidebar: reskin the whole DeepSeek Harness with one of six visual styles (Frosted Glass, Ink & Brush, Midnight Sky, Moss & Meadow, Pixel Arcade, Graphite Mono). Frosted Glass also takes a custom image backdrop with blur, haze, and panel-density controls, and every style adapts to light and dark appearance.
